title: automation: a held connector instance (a configuration fault or a refused stored credential) still tells a dispatch "the platform retries automatically", and the connectors page has no row for a configuration fault met on a retry
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Filing gate: ① a sentence that is false at named locations. Found by the #27992 card thread (PR #28014) and filed by the `domain:server` seat, because both locations are outside that card's file surface. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Drift

After PR #28014 (#27992), a degraded connector instance whose backoff retry meets a configuration fault is **held**: the retry timer and an unchanged reload no longer re-attempt it, and only an edit of its declaration or a restart does. A stored credential the upstream refuses was already held the same way (#27237).

1. `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/connector-nodes.ts:76`. A `connector_action` dispatch to a degraded instance always ends with "Dispatch is unavailable until that is resolved; the platform retries automatically." For a held instance that is false: nothing retries it, and the author has to edit the declaration (configuration) or set the credential again. The engine does not know which degraded instances are held today (`registerDegradedConnector` takes a reason, not a held flag), so the fix likely needs `engine.ts` to carry that fact. Check for serial work on `service-automation/src/engine.ts` (open PR #27951 at filing time).
2. `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx:446-456` (the failure-modes table). It has no row for a configuration fault met on a retry: the instance stays degraded with the configuration reason and is not retried until its declaration changes or a restart.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The dispatch refusal says what recovers a held instance: edit the declaration, or set the credential again. It keeps "retries automatically" only for an instance that really is on the backoff. The docs table gains the row. Pin the held wording for both the configuration and the credential case, and keep the unreachable case as a control.

## Dedupe

#27992 / PR #28014 (the retry path), #27237 (stored-credential hold), #3017 (degraded instances). No open card covers the refusal wording.
